exposure: new onset of meconium during labor
prior evidence of clear amniotic fluid
meconium present at the time of membranes rupture
outcome: persistent occiput posterior (POP) position of the fetal head
cohort: 694 singleton term deliveries complicated by intrapartum meconium-stained amniotic fluid at a tertiary referral medical center during the year 2012
finding: Secondary meconium, but not primary meconium, was independently associated with an increased risk of operative vaginal delivery and adverse neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Secondary meconium was independently associated with a higher rate of operative vaginal delivery (28.0% vs 11.4%).
